h_items.finding: No custom branch creation; unknown requirements can be admitted but coverage silently ignores them.

root_causes.why: One synthetic work/task and a fixed digest encode R1/R2 and AA/AB; not a mutable project registry.
Grant comes from launch context; all material claims compare against module POLICY/TASK, and outbox targets TASK globally. Declaration authority and branch/task mapping do not exist.
Operations only claims/append; dependencies, applicability and exclude branches explicitly enumerate AA/AB.
Binding immutable; only AA/AB heads seeded, no declaration/version tables. Final user_version=2 stamp needs explicit evolution for production policy migration.
Coverage iterates literal R1/R2 and checks only branch-head dependencies, not current criteria policy digest.
requirement_refs only checked as list field; declared membership not checked. CLIENT-ACCEPT claim is admitted in AA but never appears in residual: silent coverage blind spot.
No declaration tool or CLI --branches; programmatic Service branches argument is not a model-facing branch creation authority.
Master convergence assumes AA/AB; new schema/receipt fields must be explicitly added to closed public projection, not merged as arbitrary metadata.

options.name: Atomic reviewed baseline delta: one branch + one requirement

price.risk: medium-high: authority, schema, replay and stale-policy surface

mockup/dom_contract.py:validate parameterized by admitted registry intersect grant

options.migration: Legacy binding remains immutable genesis. Backfill registry v0 mapping AA/AB to original digest and task; separate policy-schema marker or version3 with monotone stamp and fail-closed old reader. Preserve candidates.created_at, v2 indexes and scope-bound idempotency. Unknown legacy requirement_refs become explicit LEGACY_UNMAPPED_REQUIREMENT, not deleted facts.
options.cold_start: Measured conditional simulation: 10 public calls, zero actor hashes and envelope assembly; current branch path impossible. At least fixture read, digest computation, envelope/base64 construction and operator source editing are removed from the actor path; trusted launch still needed.
options.security: Declare is not grant issuance. Exact reserved branch/task grants are verified before registry lookup, hashing and collision checks. Per-branch public token, global chain root internal; unauthorized existing/absent paths return same SCOPE_DENIED. Hidden change does not rotate visible scoped token. No L3 query oracle. Timing not proven.
options.decisions: Preserves O1 conservative invalidation, O2 origins, F-02 L1+L2 and independent baseline acceptance. O3 delivery integration not implemented in experiment; no ack is asserted. Does not grant curator admission or OMH closure.

options.name: Typed branch_decl/requirement_decl claims in a scoped control branch

mockup/storage.py:control scope and policy history schema

options.security: Grant checked both on control container and each target. Exposing one global control branch leaks registry; must shard control views or use target-scoped records. Global control digest must not act as existence oracle.
options.decisions: No implicit curator acceptance; O1 versioned criteria; no O2 redaction or O3 acknowledgement shortcut.

needs_user.title: Authority: reviewed DOM baseline delta from OMH-owned plan
needs_user.what_changes: OMH initiates branch/task references; DOM records independently admitted baseline projection, not a second plan owner.
needs_user.why: A model-facing declaration must not create planning authority or grants.

choices.effect: OMH-owned intent + independent baseline reviewer admits; recommended.
Owner preapproves manifest per launch; no dynamic declaration, lower cost.
Author self-admits declarations: changes accepted independent-review decision; not implemented.

needs_user.on_refusal: Keep read-only static registry; H7 remains.

needs_user.title: Exact reserved branch grant or namespace creation grant
needs_user.what_changes: Who reserves the customer branch code and how server gains its grant.
needs_user.why: Declaring ZX cannot authorize access to another work or branch.

choices.effect: Exact code and task ref reserved by OMH/owner at launch; one restart for future grants; prototype.
Signed create-within-namespace capability with explicit issuer, expiry and revision; less redeploy, more security code.

needs_user.on_refusal: No automatic grant expansion; branch can be admitted but inaccessible to non-granted agents.

needs_user.title: Public scoped policy token vs global policy root
needs_user.what_changes: policy_digest identifies pinned branch criteria version; internal global registry root is not sent to narrow grants.
needs_user.why: Rotating one public global hash on hidden declaration is a repeat-query existence signal, even without hidden names.

choices.effect: Per-branch public version/digest plus internal global append chain; old digest retained as v0. Recommended/prototype.
Entire project registry public to every principal; requires separate explicit authorization/declassification decision, not a harmless implementation simplification.

needs_user.on_refusal: Keep global digest internal and expose opaque scoped receipt via AN009; API adaptation needed.

needs_user.title: UD-02: empty baseline and first declaration
needs_user.what_changes: Whether reserved empty project permits proposing baseline delta without accepted requirements.
needs_user.why: Bootstrap cannot require the criterion it is itself creating.

choices.effect: Explicit NO_BASELINE/nonready; allow only reviewed bootstrap declaration, ordinary claim materialization blocked until admission. Prototype conditional behavior.
Reject all material paths until owner imports initial plan manifest; one more provisioning step.

needs_user.on_refusal: Report NO_BASELINE; do not infer coverage or allow self-bootstrap.

needs_user.title: Policy addition: conservative branch recheck or granular impact
needs_user.what_changes: Which existing reviews become noncurrent after a new requirement.
needs_user.why: Old facts must remain readable, but coverage cannot silently use outdated criteria.

choices.effect: Every claim reviewed under earlier branch policy becomes visibly noncurrent; easiest safe default, prototype.
Separate per-requirement criteria digests and independently reviewed no-impact mapping retain unaffected support; more complexity.

needs_user.on_refusal: Conservative noncurrent, preserve all immutable claim bytes and policy lineage.

needs_user.title: UD-06: convergence under divergent AA/AB policies
needs_user.what_changes: No automatic common-policy winner; decide admissible vector of branch policy digests and who reviews convergence.
needs_user.why: Meaning/text convergence is curator judgement, not equal hashes or a boolean. Direction LLM curator already accepted; execution remains open.

choices.effect: Retain independent branch versions; curator proposes vector+criteria+evidence, independent reviewer admits; master UNKNOWN until agreed contract.
Require coordinated reviewed migration to one shared policy before convergence; more blocking but easier criteria.

needs_user.on_refusal: Keep branches nonconverged/UNKNOWN, never close master.

needs_user.title: Fork detection scope and resolution
needs_user.what_changes: Same branch+requirement ID with different content is a structural declaration fork; semantic/cross-branch forks remain curator proposals.
needs_user.why: A collision must not choose the last writer. Unrelated hidden versions cannot be revealed to a narrow grant.

choices.effect: Exact target-scope identifier/content collision only, retain both proposals; independent resolution required. Prototype.
Add asynchronous semantic fork candidates from curator union view; input/model/prompt provenance and independent review required, never L3 query signals.

needs_user.on_refusal: Reject conflicting material update; keep original accepted version and both candidate evidences, no silent winner.

conflicts_with_decisions.explanation: No grant expansion, self-acceptance, hidden global digest, silent old-policy acceptance, provenance deletion, forged ack, or automatic OMH closure.
